summary: This page displays the Table of Contents for the SGX REIT annual report, listing sections such as Corporate Profile, Highlights of FY2025, Portfolio Overview, and Financial Review. No schema-relevant data is present on this page.

This page presents the Corporate Profile of Daiwa House Logistics Trust, detailing its status as an SGX-ST listed REIT focused on Asia-based logistics assets with a portfolio valuation of S$835.2 million as at 31 December 2025. It outlines the management structure under Daiwa House Asset Management Asia Pte. Ltd., the sponsor's background as Daiwa House Industry Co., Ltd., and the group's broader real estate operations across multiple countries.

This page presents the Highlights of FY2025 for SGX REIT, featuring a DPU (Distribution Per Unit) financial highlight of 4.33 cents alongside key portfolio metrics including an audited Portfolio Statement valuation of S$ 835.2 million, an occupancy rate of 87.8%, and a weighted average lease expiry of 6.6 years by GRI. The reporting unit is explicitly stated as S$ million.

This page displays the Trust Structure diagram for Daiwa House Logistics Trust, illustrating its Singapore-based entities (including Daiwa House Asset Management Asia Pte. Ltd. as REIT Manager and HSBC Institutional Trust Services (Singapore) Limited as REIT Trustee) and its overseas holdings in Japan and Vietnam managed by respective local entities. The reporting unit is specified as 31 December 2025, with no audited Portfolio Statement, financial tables, or tenant mix data present.

The main artifact on this page is the DHLT Portfolio Overview, detailing a 19-property portfolio as of 31 December 2025 with breakdowns by region (Greater Tokyo 43.2%, Hokkaido/Tohoku 33.8%), land tenure (Freehold 61.3%, >40Y 26.5%), asset type (Multi-tenanted 76.0%, Built-to-suit 24.0%), green rating (6-Stars 60.6%), and solar panel status (Installed 74.7%). The reporting unit for valuations and percentages is implicitly based on the portfolio valuation without an explicit currency or scale notation such as SGD'000 or S$ million.

This page presents the audited Portfolio Statement listing 17 properties across Japan, Vietnam, and other regions with their completion years, net lettable areas (NLA), and land tenure details as of 31 December 2025. The reporting unit is not explicitly defined in the text, but the data aligns with a portfolio overview table rather than a financial statement schema requiring specific currency formatting like SGD'000 or S$ million.

This page presents a Portfolio Overview table detailing property types, Weighted Average Lease Expiration (WALE) by GRI in years, occupancy rates, and financial metrics including Gross Revenue and Net Property Income in JPY millions for multi-tenanted and single-tenanted assets. The reporting unit is explicitly stated as JPY millions, with no audited portfolio statement, total return data, or tenant mix information present.

This page details the physical attributes and valuation of the DPL Sapporo Higashi Kariki property, including its freehold tenure, 61,610 sqm land area, JPY 13,700 million valuation as at 31 December 2025, and 100.0% occupancy status with eight warehouse units for multiple tenants. No schema-relevant data such as audited Portfolio Statements, financial highlights, or tenant mix tables are present on this page.

This page details the property profile of DPL Sendai Port, a two-storey industrial warehouse located in Sendai, Japan, with no audited Portfolio Statement, financial highlights, or tenant mix data present. The asset comprises 63,117 sqm of NLA valued at JPY 13,500 million as of 31 December 2025, featuring 204 parking bays and dedicated loading/unloading facilities for multiple tenants.

This page presents the audited Portfolio Statement (property valuations) for the DPL Gunma Fujioka asset, detailing its land address in Greater Tokyo region, completion date of 6 January 2022, and occupancy as of 31 December 2025 at 100.0%. Key property metrics include freehold tenure with a WALE of 5.3 years, land area of 33,782 sqm, NLA of 22,514 sqm, purchase consideration of JPY 3,990 million, and valuation of JPY 5,230 million as at 31 December 2025.

This page details the property-specific attributes of DPL Okayama Hayashima, including its land address, completion dates, occupancy status, tenure, valuation, and physical specifications. No schema-relevant data such as audited portfolio statements, financial highlights, or tenant tables are present on this page.

This page presents a property profile for D Project Fukuoka Tobara S, detailing its location in Fukuoka, Japan, completion date of 21 February 2019, and key metrics including 100.0% occupancy as of 31 December 2025, a gross development value (Gri) of 8.6 years, land area of 14,439 sqm, purchase consideration of JPY 1,260 million, and a valuation of JPY 1,400 million as at 31 December 2025. No schema-relevant data such as audited portfolio statements, financial highlights, tenant mix, or reporting unit currency figures are present on this page.

This page presents the Operational Review of DHLT's portfolio, featuring a table detailing Occupancy Rates by region as of 31 December 2025 (87.8% overall) and a chart illustrating Portfolio Lease Expiry percentages from 2026 to beyond. Additionally, it includes a "Top 10 Tenant" table showing the breakdown of Net Property Income (% of NPI) for key tenants, with Mitsubishi Shokuhin leading at 24.5%, alongside sector-specific data indicating 79.6% of tenants operate in the 3PL trade sector.

This page presents the DHLT Portfolio acquisition of DPL Gunma Fujioka and reports the portfolio valuation as S$835.2 million (SGD'000) as at 31 December 2025, alongside a table detailing the property's acquisition price versus its year-end valuation.

This page presents the Japan and Vietnam Portfolio Valuations for 31 Dec 2024 and 31 Dec 2025 in JPY million and VND billion respectively, followed by a VALUATION BREAKDOWN BY PROPERTIES table detailing asset contributions by region. The page also includes Sponsor's obligations regarding six leasehold properties within the DHLT Portfolio as of 31 December 2025.

This page presents the Financial Review for SGX REIT FY2025, featuring a main table detailing financial highlights such as Gross Revenue (S\$'000), Net Property Income (NPI) (S\$'000), Distributable Income (S\$'000), and Distribution per Unit (cents). The content includes specific notes on property expenses in S\$'000 and Japanese portfolio performance with Gross Rental Income and NPI reported in JPY million.

This page presents the Prudent Capital Management financial indicators and Debt Maturity Profile for Prudential Capital Management as at 31 December 2025, reporting Total assets of S\$1,060.4 million, Net asset of S\$493.1 million, aggregate leverage of 40.2%, and an interest coverage ratio of 5.5 times. The debt maturity table details obligations in S\$ million ranging from S\$98.4m due in 2026 to S\$82.0m in 2030, alongside notes on refinancing activities, fixed-rate exposure, and undrawn facilities.

This page presents unit price information, monthly trading performance charts and tables, and index comparisons for the SGX REIT's FY2025 period (1 January 2025 to 31 December 2025), reporting values in S$ with volumes in '000. It explicitly states a total return of 5.43% assuming reinvested dividends but does not contain audited portfolio statements, profit or loss data, tenant mix, distribution highlights, or manager/trustee details.

This page presents the "Material Topics, Targets and Performance" table for the SGX REIT's FY2025 sustainability report under IFRS S2 34(c), 34(d), detailing economic performance goals and environmental targets (Energy, Emissions, Water) aligned with UN SDGs. The content outlines previously set targets achieved in FY2025 (e.g., 72.2% solar power capacity, 18.8 MWp aggregate capacity) alongside new FY2026 KPIs such as achieving 100% efficiency equipment installation and increasing solar capacity to 25MWp by 2030.

This page contains a **Sustainability Commitment table** detailing UN SDG targets, material topics, FY2025 performance, and FY2026 KPIs across categories including Waste Management, Quality Assets and Green Building Management, Diversity and Equal Opportunity, Decent Work and Economic Growth, and Training and Education.

This page presents the Stakeholder Engagement table from DHLT's Sustainability Report, detailing engagement methods and issues for Unitholders, Tenants, Local Communities, Officers and Employees, Supply Chain, and Sponsor. The reporting unit is not explicitly stated in the text, so no specific currency or unit schema can be confirmed.

This page of the SGX REIT sustainability report details the Manager's environmental initiatives and energy management for DHLT properties in Japan, reporting data in GJ (Gigajoules) without using the requested schema-relevant units such as SGD'000 or S$ million. The section includes a table comparing FY2024 and FY2025 energy consumption (7,470.29 GJ vs 7,107.40 GJ) and intensity across 8 to 9 assets, alongside text describing solar panel installations on 13 of 19 portfolio properties and tenant-led conservation efforts.

This page of the SGX REIT annual report features a **Solar Power Capacity** table listing individual property capacities totaling 18.8 MWp for FY2025, alongside text detailing the Manager's ENRM Framework and climate-related scenario analysis disclosures.

This page presents a Sustainability Report focusing on environmental management, specifically detailing waste generation metrics from the MTBs table which shows a 27.51% decrease in total weight of waste generated (27.40 tonnes) in FY2025 compared to FY2024 for five assets. The content outlines the Manager's commitment to Japan's circular economy goals, green building initiatives including GRI 3-3 targets for 90% green certification of new multi-tenant properties, and operational strategies such as tenant cooperation and waste segregation without providing audited portfolio statements, financial highlights, or tenant mix data.

This page contains a BELS Rating table detailing the star ratings, property listings, and Net Lettable Area (NLA) percentages for 19 green-certified properties within DHLT's portfolio as of 31 December 2025, showing a total NLA coverage of 95.2%. The text also outlines the Management Approach to environmental performance, including the requirement for tenants to provide utility consumption data under green lease clauses, with 100% of new and renewed agreements incorporating this clause in FY2025.

This page of the SGX REIT Sustainability Report presents a table titled "DHLT's Annual Tenant Satisfaction Survey Response Rate" showing response percentages for FY2025 (97.3%), 2024 (84.2%), and 2023 (85.7%). The reporting unit is percentage (%) as no monetary or property-specific schema-relevant data such as audited portfolio statements, revenue tables, or tenant mix are present.
This page presents the GRI Content Index for the Sustainability Report, detailing disclosure status and section references for standards 2-18 through 3-2. No schema-relevant data is present.

This page contains the GRI Content Index for the SGX REIT Sustainability Report, outlining disclosure requirements across Economic Performance, Energy and Emissions Management, Climate Change Mitigation, and Water Management. No schema-relevant data such as audited Portfolio Statements, financial tables, or tenant information is present on this page.

This page contains the GRI Content Index for the Sustainability Report, listing material topics such as Waste Management, Quality Assets, Diversity, Training, and Occupational Health and Safety with their corresponding GRI standards, disclosure sections, and references to pages 80–85. No schema-relevant data.

This page of the SGX REIT sustainability report presents a SASB Content Index table detailing DHLT's environmental risks, including water management strategies and flood zone exposure for Japan assets across 19 properties. The reporting unit is SGD'000 where applicable, though financial metrics are not present; instead, activity metrics show leasable floor area at 499,227.5 m² and average occupancy at 91.3%.

This page contains an IFRS S2 content index table detailing indicators for climate-related scenario analysis (section 74-76) and risk management processes (sections 74, 77, 79). No schema-relevant data.

This page contains the IFRS S2 content index and climate-related metrics section of the Sustainability Report, detailing requirements for greenhouse gas emissions disclosures including Scope 1, 2, and 3 categories. It explicitly notes that DHLT STB are excluded from consolidated portfolio Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions using the operational control approach, while confirming no contractual instruments are used for Scope 2 accounting.

This page presents the IFRS S2 Sustainability Report content index, listing indicators for Scope 3 emissions, climate-related risks and opportunities, capital deployment, internal carbon pricing, executive remuneration linkages, and climate-related targets with their corresponding section references. No audited Portfolio Statement, financial statements, tenant mix, or distribution data are present on this page.

This page presents market overview data for the SGX REIT Japan LMT portfolio, featuring Figure 2 (Japan LMT Vacancy Rates) and Figure 3 (Effective Rent Indices) covering four regions from Q1 2018 to Q4 2027 with forecasts starting in Q3 2025. The content includes no schema-relevant data such as audited Portfolio Statements, financial statements, revenue/expenses, tenant tables, or distribution highlights.

This page presents market overview data for the Greater Osaka long-term rental (LMT) sector, primarily through Figure 6's table detailing annual supply-demand balance metrics including new supply, net absorption, and vacancy rates from 2007 to 2027. The second artifact is a table displaying quarterly effective rent indices in JPY/tsubo across Central, Waterfront, Peripheral, and Greater Osaka areas from Q1 2020 to Q4 2027.

This page presents market overview data for the Greater Nagoya region, led by **Figure 8: Greater Nagoya LMT Supply-Demand Balance**, a table and chart detailing new supply, net absorption, and vacancy rates from 2007 to 2027 in tsubo and percentage. The reporting unit is **tsubo** for volume metrics and **%** for vacancy rates, with Q4 2025 vacancy recorded at 15.5% and 2026 forecasted at 15.0%.

This page presents the Greater Nagoya Effective Rent Index (Figure 9) and market analysis for Greater Fukuoka, displaying quarterly index data from Q1 2020 to Q4 2027 in JPY/tsubo alongside commentary on vacancy rates, new supply forecasts, and rent trends. No schema-relevant data such as audited Portfolio Statements, financial highlights, or tenant tables are present.

This page presents Figure 10, a table and chart detailing the Greater Fukuoka Long-Term Lease (LMT) Supply-Demand Balance from 2013 to 2027, including new supply, net absorption, and vacancy rates in tsubo and percentage terms. It also contains Figure 11, which tracks the Effective Rent Index for the same region from Q1 2020 to Q4 2027 in JPY/tsubo, with data sourced from CBRE Research as of Q4 2025.

This page presents market overview data for Japan's commercial real estate sector, featuring a table of average assumed achievable rent by prefecture (Q1 2024–Q4 2025) and a comprehensive table detailing Japan total commercial real estate investment volume by asset type from 2005 to Q4 2025.

This page presents a market overview and outlook for the Japanese logistics sector, featuring CBRE's Q4 2025 Cap Rate Survey table detailing average expected NCF yields by region (Tokyo Bay area, Tokyo Inland area, Aichi, Osaka, and Fukuoka) alongside a bar chart of the same data. No audited Portfolio Statement, financial statements, gross revenue notes, tenant mix, or distribution highlights are present on this page.

This page of the SGX REIT annual report presents a table detailing the fees paid to Directors for FY2025, reporting amounts in S\$ (Singapore dollars) with values ranging from Nil to S\$125,200. The content includes specific fee breakdowns by Director designation and attendance type, along with explanatory notes regarding tax deductions, sponsor assignments, and the absence of variable or long-term incentives for key management personnel.

This page presents the Corporate Governance Report detailing the remuneration policy for Key Management Personnel (KMPs) and provides a Total Remuneration table for the CEO of DHLT for FY2025 in SGD'000. The document explicitly names Mr Jun Yamamura as the CEO, lists five KMPs with their specific roles and remuneration band breakdowns, and states that no unit incentives or shares were paid in the year.

This page (153-165) indexes the SGX'000 financial statements for SGX REIT, listing key artifacts including the Independent Auditor's Report, Distribution Statement, Consolidated Statements of Comprehensive Income and Financial Position, and the Statement of Portfolio.

This page presents the Independent Auditor's Report on the financial statements of Daiwa House Logistics Trust (DHLT) for the year ended 31 December 2025, explicitly naming the Statement of Portfolio as a component of the audited reports. The report details the auditor's opinion that the consolidated financial statements comply with IFRSs and relevant Singapore regulations, and identifies the valuation of investment properties (carrying amount S\$984.1 million at 92.8% of total assets) as a Key Audit Matter due to its sensitivity to market assumptions.

This page presents the **Statements of Financial Position** for SGX REIT as at 31 December 2025, reporting Group and Trust totals in S$'000 with Net Asset Value per Unit in S$. The table details current and non-current assets including investment properties and cash equivalents, alongside liabilities such as loans and lease obligations, culminating in total equity represented by unitholders' funds and perpetual securities.

This page presents the Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income for SGX REIT's financial year ended 31 December 2025, reporting a Total Return of S$'000 35,654 and Net Property Income of S$'000 44,199. Key line items include Gross Revenue of S$'000 57,794, Property Expenses of S$'000 (13,595), Manager's management fees of S$'000 (2,075), Finance expenses of S$'000 (9,216), and Tax expenses of S$'000 (6,073).

This page presents the **Distribution Statement** for SGX REIT for the financial year ended 31 December 2025, reporting amounts in S$'000. It details the income available for distribution, total distributions paid to unitholders (including quarterly DPU rates of 4.33 cents), and specific distribution adjustments such as manager's management fees, fair value changes in investment properties and derivatives, unrealised forex gains/losses, amortisation of loan upfront fees, and deferred tax expenses.

This page presents the **Statement of Changes in Unitholders' Funds** for SGX REIT for the financial year ended 31 December 2025, reporting Group and Trust unitholders' funds in S$'000. The table details operations including total return attributable to unitholders (S$35,654k for Group), net increases from operations, unitholder transactions such as manager's fees and distributions, foreign currency translation reserves, perpetual securities movements, and the final balance at end of the year.

This page presents the CONSOLIDATED STATEMENT OF CASH FLOWS for the financial year ended 31 December 2025, reporting net cash flows generated from operating activities of S$'000 38,767 and net cash used in investing activities of S$'000 (35,957). The table details cash movements including distribution paid to unitholders of S$'000 (32,032) and net decrease in cash and cash equivalents of S$'000 (7,862), with all figures denominated in SGD'000.

This page presents the Audited Portfolio Statement for SGX REIT, detailing 20 properties across Japan and Vietnam with their carrying values as at 31 December 2025 reported in S$'000. The table lists geographic locations, acquisition dates, tenure types, and asset valuations, culminating in a total investment property value of S$835,157 (S$'000) which represents 182.6% of net assets attributable to unitholders.

This page contains notes to the financial statements detailing fee structures under property management and building management agreements for the SGX REIT, including specific percentages, fixed amounts in JPY/VND/S$, and minimums applied to gross revenue or construction costs. No audited Portfolio Statement, Top-N tenants table, DPU highlights, or other schema-relevant data are present on this page.

This page contains Notes to the Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, reporting in SGD'000. It details Japan asset management fees payable to GK1 and TMK, confirms compliance with IFRS and MAS CIS Code requirements, notes a net current liability position of S$36.6 million, and outlines critical accounting estimates including expected credit losses, fair value derivatives, and investment property valuations.
This page contains no schema-relevant data.

This page of the SGX REIT annual report for the year ended 31 December 2025 presents accounting policy notes on distribution, cash equivalents, restricted cash, and receivables, followed by a table showing Group and Trust cash and cash equivalents in S$'000.

This page of the SGX REIT annual report for the year ended 31 December 2025 contains Notes 6 to 8 detailing trade receivables impairment, prepaid expenses and other assets (reported in SGD'000), and financial derivatives, with no audited Portfolio Statement, Statement of Total Return, gross revenue/expense notes, Top-N tenants, or manager/trustee/sponsor information present.

This page presents the Consolidated Statement of Portfolio (property valuations) for investment properties and right-of-use assets, detailing the year-end carrying value of S$984,117,000 (2025) versus S$996,406,000 (2024), alongside a breakdown of fair value changes, acquisitions, capital expenditure, and foreign exchange impacts recorded in SGD'000.

This page presents a table detailing the significant unobservable inputs used in Level 3 fair value measurements for investment properties, specifically covering Japan and Vietnam. The data includes valuation techniques such as the discounted cash flow approach, along with specific ranges or values for rental rates per Tsubo/sq metres, discount rates, and terminal capitalisation rates for both 2025 and 2024, without any schema-relevant financial statement data like audited portfolio statements, total return figures, or tenant information.

This page contains Level 3 fair value details for Japan and Vietnam properties alongside a Statement of Portfolio listing audited subsidiaries (DH-Crux Pte. Ltd., DH-CRUX Japan entities, and DH Logistics Management Vietnam Co., Ltd.) with their effective equity interests held at 100%. No financial highlights such as total return, profit or loss, gross revenue, or tenant mix data are present on this page.

This page presents the **Investment in Subsidiaries** and **Trade and Other Payables** notes from the SGX REIT annual report for the financial year ended 31 December 2025, detailing a cash acquisition of D Project Tan Duc 2 valued at S$'000 with a net asset fair value of S$12,254. It also provides comparative balances for Group and Trust trade payables, other payables, and accrued expenses reported in S$'000.

This page of the SGX REIT annual report for the financial year ended 31 December 2025 presents notes on Trade and Other Payables, Lease Liabilities, and Loans and Borrowings, with all figures reported in S$'000. The main artifacts include a detailed breakdown of Group and Trust lease liabilities (including payments, finance costs, and exchange differences) and total borrowings split between current and non-current categories, alongside unamortised transaction costs and the percentage of borrowings to net assets.

This page details the Group's loan facilities and borrowings as of 31 December 2025, including specific debt instruments from DH-CRUX Japan TMK and DHLT, alongside a table presenting the outstanding principal, interest rates, and carrying amounts for bank loans and bonds reported in SGD'000. It further provides a reconciliation of movements in liabilities to cash flows arising from financing activities, showing face value, carrying amount, recognition/repayment, transaction costs, finance expense, and currency translation impacts for both the Group and lease liabilities across the years ended 31 December 2025 and 2024.

This page presents the audited Portfolio Statement for deferred tax liabilities, detailing balances of S$32,299 (2025) and S$28,202 (2024) in SGD'000, alongside a movement table showing fair-value changes, tax depreciation, and exchange differences. It also provides notes on perpetual securities issued by DHLT, classified as equity instruments with a carrying value of S$35.8 million (2025) and S$35.8 million (2024).

The page presents the "Units in Issue and to Be Issued" table for SGX REIT, detailing the 2025 and 2024 financial years with unit counts and values reported in SGD'000. It further describes the issuance of approximately 1,904,000 new units to satisfy the Manager's base fee during the year ended 31 December 2025 and outlines the rights and liabilities associated with Unit holders under the Trust Deed.

This page presents financial statement notes for the SGX REIT year ended 31 December 2025, featuring tables reporting NAV and NTA per unit in S$'000, gross revenue (rental and other income) totaling S\$57,794, property operating expenses of S\$13,595, and other trust expenses of S\$773, all denominated in S\$'000.

This page of the SGX REIT annual report for the year ended 31 December 2025 presents detailed Notes to the Financial Statements covering Finance Expenses, Tax Expenses (including current and deferred components), and Earnings Per Unit. All financial figures are reported in SGD'000 for amounts and '000 units for share counts, detailing interest expense, tax reconciliations, and basic/diluted earnings per unit calculations.

This page presents the Operating Segments table for the financial year ended 31 December 2025, reporting SG$'000 for Japan and Vietnam. The main artifact details gross revenue of 57,794 (SG$'000), property expenses, net property income of 44,199 (SG$'000), finance costs, and total profit after tax of 35,654 (SG$'000).

This page presents the Operating Segments table (continued) for the year ended 31 December 2024, detailing segment results including gross revenue of S$'000 and property expenses by Japan, Vietnam, and Total regions, alongside a comprehensive breakdown of unallocated amounts such as management fees, trustee fees, trust expenses, finance expenses, foreign exchange gains, and fair value changes leading to total profit after tax of S$'000. The page also includes Segment Assets and Liabilities as at 31 December 2024 in S$'000, listing investment properties and other assets/liabilities before consolidated totals, followed by text under Capital Management outlining the Manager's objectives regarding capital structure, yield monitoring, and distribution levels within reporting units expressed in S$'000.

This page details the Group's capital management compliance and financial risk management objectives, specifically outlining foreign currency exposures denominated in JPY and USD for both the Group and Trust. The reporting unit is S$'000 as indicated in the table headers for the years ended 31 December 2025 and 2024.

This page details the Group's financial risk management policies, specifically presenting a sensitivity analysis table for foreign currency risk (JPY and USD) impacting profit or loss in S$'000 and another table showing interest rate risk impact on floating rate borrowings also in S$'000. No audited Portfolio Statement, DPU/financial highlights, or Top-N tenants tables are present; the reporting unit is consistently stated as S$'000.

This page presents the contractual maturities of financial liabilities for the Group and its subsidiaries for the years ended 31 December 2025 and 2024, reported in S$'000. The main table details non-derivative financial liabilities including trade and other payables, security deposits, lease liabilities, asset retirement obligation, and loans and borrowings, categorized by carrying amount and cash flow maturities within one year, between two to five years, and more than five years.

This page of the SGX REIT annual report for the financial year ended 31 December 2025 contains a Liquidity risk table detailing contractual maturities of financial liabilities in SGD'000 and a Fair Values of Assets and Liabilities table reporting Group financial instruments with carrying amounts and fair values (Level 1, Level 2, Level 3) in S$'000.

This page of the SGX REIT annual report presents **NOTES TO THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS** for the year ended 31 December 2025, specifically detailing **FAIR VALUES OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES (CONT'D)** in SGD'000. The main table classifies financial instruments into levels within the fair value hierarchy, reporting carrying amounts and fair values for derivative assets/liabilities under both the Trust (2025) and Group (2024), while noting that current assets and liabilities approximate their fair values due to short maturity periods.

This page presents a continuation of the Fair Values of Assets and Liabilities table (Note 27) detailing financial assets at amortised cost, fair value through profit or loss (FVTPL), and loans/borrowings for the SGX REIT Trust in S$'000, alongside a description of valuation techniques used for Level 2 and Level 3 instruments. It also includes an operating lease commitments table (Note 28) showing non-cancellable rentals receivable by Group for the years 2025 and 2024 in S$'000.

This page presents the SGX'000 audited Portfolio Statement for significant related party transactions and financial ratios (expressed in S$'000) for SGX REIT. The main artifacts include a table detailing expenses paid to the Trustee, Sponsor, and Manager alongside ground rent, electricity, and management fees, as well as tables showing expense-to-net-asset ratios, portfolio turnover rates, and sensitivity analysis on interest coverage.

This page contains notes on subsequent events and authorisation for the SGX REIT financial year ended 31 December 2025, specifically detailing a S$40.0 million credit facility obtained in January 2026 and a distribution of 2.09 Singapore cents per Unit announced in February 2026. No schema-relevant data.

This page details SGX-ST and Property Funds Appendix compliant Interested Person Transactions for FY2025, presented in a table reporting aggregate values in S$'000 for Daiwa House Asset Management Asia Pte. Ltd. (Manager) and Daiwa House Industry Co., Ltd. and its subsidiaries (Sponsor), alongside HSBC Institutional Trust Service (Singapore) Ltd (Trustee). The table explicitly lists specific fee categories such as management fees, acquisition fees, rent, ground rent, electricity, repair costs, distribution to perpetual securities holders, and trustee fees, confirming the reporting unit as S$'000 without providing audited portfolio statements or total return data.

This page presents the **Statistics of Unitholdings** for Daiwa House Logistics Trust as at 12 March 2026, featuring a table detailing the distribution of unitholdings by size (number of units and percentage) and a **Top-N tenants/customers table** listing the twenty largest unitholders with their unit counts and ownership percentages. The reporting unit is expressed in Units, with the total issued and fully paid-up units amounting to 700,739,269 Units.

This page presents the Statistics of Unitholdings for Daiwa House Logistics Trust as at 12 March 2026, featuring a table of Substantial Unitholders' unitholdings (recorded in SGD units) and a separate table detailing Directors' unitholdings. The section concludes with a Public Float disclosure stating that approximately 79.1% of the Units are held in public hands.

This page contains the Notice of Annual General Meeting (AGM) for Daiwa House Logistics Trust (DHLT) scheduled for 24 April 2026, convening unitholders to adopt the audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 and pass a general mandate for issuing new units or convertible securities. No schema-relevant data such as audited portfolio statements, profit or loss tables, DPU highlights, tenant mix, or unit-level reporting figures are present on this page.

Ltd.), trustee (HSBC Institutional Trust Services (Singapore) Limited), auditors (Ernst & Young LLP), unit registrar, board of directors, and audit and risk committee members. No schema-relevant data such as financial statements, portfolio details, or distribution highlights are present on this page.
